name: Cuộn phim của hai mình
prompt: Create ONE polished high-fidelity desktop website SECTION mockup for the Vietnamese couples app Flamee, not an entire landing page and not a moodboard containing multiple concepts. Single horizontal canvas, about 1536x1024. The section is Kỷ niệm (shared memories), to follow four iPhone feature sections, so this concept MUST NOT include any phone or tablet frame. Established brand: luminous warm ivory fine art paper with delicate visible fibres, very subtle warm natural light, dark espresso #302924 body copy, muted terracotta #AC603D editorial quote, coral #FF7158 for small real controls. Cormorant Garamond italic for expressive headline, Be Vietnam Pro for clean readable UI/body. Premium calm romantic editorial aesthetic, generous calibrated margins, substantial photographs and real content, not generic SaaS cards or gradients. A small subtle translucent flame-logo pill reading 'Kỷ niệm' may identify the section. No large outer container box, no browser chrome, no desktop mockup framing, no fake statistics, no testimonial claims, no pricing, no emoji glyphs, no giant decorative numbers. All photographs are believable sample memories of a Vietnamese couple in their twenties: black-haired woman in a cream blouse, black-haired man in an olive overshirt, candid café, a seaside sunset, a quiet walk. Tasteful authentic warm grading; photographs must be beautiful and feel emotionally specific. All dates and captions are mock content for a design preview. Live Vietnamese text must be clean and readable, with correct diacritics. Top-level headline should take at most two lines. This is an intentional designed usable web composition, not a photograph of a physical desk unless objects are explicitly part of the concept. CONCEPT: CINEMATIC MEMORY FILM. Full-width immersive horizontal photo rail is the dominant event. Top quarter has a left aligned small 'Kỷ niệm' badge, large two-line editorial headline 'Những ngày có nhau,\nđều đáng nhớ.' and short subtitle 'Kéo để xem lại những khoảnh khắc của hai mình.' A single confident photo rail occupies most of the width and the middle/bottom two-thirds: five distinct memory photographs, central landscape seaside-sunset photograph much larger and fully sharp, the two neighboring photos smaller with deliberate glimpses of further images cropped at the outer page edges. The photos are square-cornered editorial images, not Polaroids, no film sprocket holes, no heavy dark stage. Subtle depth and scale convey a horizontal draggable cinematic gallery. Below the center photo set 'Hoàng hôn hôm ấy' with date '12.10.2026' and a short caption 'Chẳng cần đi đâu xa, chỉ cần đi cùng nhau.' Bottom right a small pair of flat circular previous/next arrows and a tiny clear row of progress dots. Keep bottom content visible. Typography and imagery dominate, no phone. A premium photo essay with tangible paper background and an obvious interaction.
